feature: Explicit opt-in summary cache in AgentHost and CLI; offline host integration only

settings.requires: Both explicit IDs plus memory_root; all None preserves defaults
settings.ids: Builtin str only; exact [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}; no normalization or inference
settings.summarizer: Existing StubSummarizer, 120-character limit; policy label is not model identity proof

ownership: Cache constructor failure attempts raw close once; Memory owns both stores from constructor entry including restore failure; later bind/decision/ScheduledAgent failure closes completed facade once; population failure attempts all previous memories. Secondary cleanup or add_note failures cannot replace original error object/errno/frame. Cleanup notes contain no exception content.
verified_behaviors: Behavioral RED before new API: old host recomputed seven summaries from four raw notes
Cached host reconstruction reuses existing nodes; fifth note computes only one missing leaf
Fresh local process uses exploding summarizer with zero old-summary calls
Scheduled agent and brain share one facade; inspector binds same private source log; foreign-persona notes excluded
Explicit worlds use distinct user-selected raw roots and cache namespace identities
Wrong world/persona/policy, copied policy and changed raw source binding refused without regeneration
Strict API/CLI preflight before RNG, roster, manifest, autodetection or storage allocations; invalid types including string subclasses rejected
Disconnect/reconnect retains same memory and both process locks; normal stop permits fresh-process reconstruction
Local worker/inspector threads joined before raw/cache close
Cache/raw-restore/cache-restore/bind/decision/ScheduledAgent failures preserve original object/errno/frame and attempt every owned close once
Release-before-raise errors do not halt other persona cleanup; failing add_note cannot mask origin
Pre-release close failure retains real lock, observed before explicit fixture recovery
Session append failure still disconnects all fake clients and attempts dual-resource cleanup
Raw-only default creates no summary-cache subtree and still recomputes on restart

verification.environment: Existing pinned nix develop --offline and uv run --offline --no-sync; no installs or dependency changes
verification.coverage_scope: Three owned source modules, not whole-project coverage; CLI.main/host.run intentionally unexecuted
verification.warning: One existing fastapi.testclient StarletteDeprecationWarning; dependencies unchanged
verification.fixed_local_check_issue: Initial Bandit flagged construction-invariant asserts; replaced with type casts after pure preflight, then all final checks rerun successfully
verification.full_combined_gate: Not run while concurrent unrelated writer active; parent owns completed combined snapshot and independent feature review

limits: No live CLI.main/host.run, real provider/socket/server, native gameplay, SQL, container/volume, deployment/bootstrap effects
Synthetic personas, FakeGameClient and injected counting/exploding summarizers only; zero old-summary calls are not live Qwen billing or native evidence
Inherited backend pre-release fd/flock retention remains possible even with cleared fd slot; attempts and notes do not guarantee release or recovery
Repeated prefix hashing remains quadratic; no accepted backend/facade optimization
World cache IDs are labels, not resource authority; raw root remains explicit user-selected per world
No native startup guard/gate/whitelist/accepted core/cache/backend/old-test changes; no staging/commit/push

artifacts.scratch_lifetime: Scratch may be pruned after 24h idle; parsed counts and fingerprints are retained here
